30: // ---------- Library (global singleton JSON blob) ----------
31: 
32: /** Thrown when a library write's `updated_at` precondition doesn't match ΓÇö i.e. someone else
33:  *  saved between this request's read and its write. `status` is read by index.ts's error
34:  *  middleware, same as the shared `CampaignArchivedError` family. */
35: export class LibraryConflictError extends Error {
36:   readonly status = 409;
37:   constructor() {
38:     super('Someone else saved the library while you were editing. Reload and reapply your change.');
39:   }
40: }
41: 
42: /** Every library write is a read-modify-write of the *entire* 16-key blob, so without a
43:  *  precondition two admins editing unrelated records in unrelated collections silently clobber
44:  *  each other ΓÇö last writer wins, and the changelog records both as successful. `version` is the
45:  *  row's `updated_at` exactly as Postgres returned it; hand it back to `saveLibrary` to make the
46:  *  write conditional.
47:  *
48:  *  Caveat worth knowing: this is millisecond-resolution time, not a monotonic counter, so two
49:  *  writes landing inside the same millisecond could both pass the check. Closing that properly
50:  *  needs a real version column and a migration; for a tool with a handful of admins the time
51:  *  precondition removes the realistic window, and it needs no schema change. */
52: export async function getLibraryWithVersion(): Promise<{ library: Library; version: string }> {
53:   const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('library').select('data, updated_at').eq('id', 'singleton').maybeSingle();
54:   if (error) throw error;
55:   if (!data) throw new Error('Library not seeded');
56:   const raw = data.data as Library;
57:   const version = data.updated_at as string;
58:   const normalized = normalizeLibrary(raw);
59:   // Self-heal a Library row missing a field added after it was seeded, so future reads don't
60:   // need to repeat this ΓÇö same pattern as getSheet's Recoveries/Scars backfill. Compares every
61:   // key rather than the six this used to name by hand: villains/npcs/locations (0.35.0) and
62:   // loadTiers were all added later and were never in that list, so a row missing one of them
63:   // re-normalized on every single read and never healed.
64:   const healed = (Object.keys(normalized) as (keyof Library)[]).some((k) => normalized[k] !== raw[k]);
65:   if (healed) {
66:     try {
67:       return { library: normalized, version: await saveLibrary(normalized, version) };
68:     } catch (err) {
69:       // Another request healed it first. Ours is equivalent, so serve it and let the caller's
70:       // own write fail its precondition if it has one ΓÇö never fail a *read* over this.
71:       if (!(err instanceof LibraryConflictError)) throw err;
72:     }
73:   }
74:   return { library: normalized, version };
75: }

77: export async function getLibrary(): Promise<Library> {
78:   return (await getLibraryWithVersion()).library;
79: }

81: /** Returns the new version (the row's `updated_at` as Postgres stored it), so a caller doing
82:  *  several writes in a row can chain preconditions. Omitting `expectedVersion` writes
83:  *  unconditionally ΓÇö that's the seed/import/reset path, where replacing whatever is there is the
84:  *  whole point; per-record edits should always pass one. */
85: export async function saveLibrary(lib: Library, expectedVersion?: string): Promise<string> {
86:   if (expectedVersion === undefined) {
87:     const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
88:       .from('library')
89:       .upsert({ id: 'singleton', data: lib, updated_at: nowIso() })
90:       .select('updated_at')
91:       .maybeSingle();
92:     if (error) throw error;
93:     return (data?.updated_at as string) ?? nowIso();
94:   }
95: 
96:   const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
97:     .from('library')
98:     .update({ data: lib, updated_at: nowIso() })
99:     .eq('id', 'singleton')
100:     .eq('updated_at', expectedVersion)
101:     .select('updated_at');
102:   if (error) throw error;
103:   if (!data || data.length === 0) throw new LibraryConflictError();
104:   return data[0].updated_at as string;
105: }

463: /** Shared by `getSheet` and `listSheetsForCampaign`: normalizes a raw JSONB sheet and reports
464:  * whether the normalized form differs from what was stored, so the caller can write back a
465:  * self-heal for a sheet missing fields added since it was last saved ΓÇö pre-0.13.0/pre-0.18.0
466:  * (Scars/Wealth/Treasure/Hold) or pre-V0.6-slice-1 (Strain/Statuses/HealingTrack/Boons/Banes) ΓÇö
467:  * same pattern as campaign.ts's bootstrap route backfilling a missing Party row. */
468: function normalizeAndCheckHeal(raw: CharacterSheet): { normalized: CharacterSheet; needsHeal: boolean } {
469:   const normalized = normalizeSheet(raw);
470:   const needsHeal =
471:     normalized.Strain !== raw.Strain ||
472:     normalized.Statuses !== raw.Statuses ||
473:     normalized.HealingTrack !== raw.HealingTrack ||
474:     normalized.Boons !== raw.Boons ||
475:     normalized.Banes !== raw.Banes ||
476:     normalized.Scars !== raw.Scars ||
477:     normalized.Wealth !== raw.Wealth ||
478:     normalized.Treasure !== raw.Treasure ||
479:     normalized.Hold !== raw.Hold;
480:   return { normalized, needsHeal };
481: }

483: export async function getSheet(characterId: string): Promise<CharacterSheet | null> {
484:   const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('character_sheets').select('data, campaign_id').eq('character_id', characterId).maybeSingle();
485:   if (error) throw error;
486:   if (!data) return null;

604: export async function withBondLock<T>(
605:   bondId: string,
606:   mutate: (bond: Bond) => T | Promise<T>,

608:   const client = await pgPool.connect();

610:     await client.query('BEGIN');

614:       return null;
615:     }
616:     const bond = rows[0].data;
617:     const result = await mutate(bond);
618:     await client.query('UPDATE bonds SET data = $1, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $2', [JSON.stringify(bond), bondId]);
619:     await client.query('COMMIT');
620:     return { bond, result };
621:   } catch (err) {
622:     await client.query('ROLLBACK').catch(() => {});
623:     throw err;
624:   } finally {
625:     client.release();
626:   }
